overview.html:
AI Homework & Embeddable Content

A comprehensive system for homework improvement, generation, and auto-grading—plus a rich library of embeddable content types that can be integrated into lectures, assignments, and any educational material.

🎯 Key Value Proposition

Teachers can embed rich, interactive content anywhere—and students experience engaging, modern learning materials that compete with entertainment.

Marketing Angle

This serves as both a product feature AND a marketing showcase. A live interactive page demonstrates all embeddable content types—perfect for sales demos, teacher onboarding, and investor presentations.

customSections.title: 📊 Embeddable Content Types
customSections.html:
All content types that can be embedded into lectures, assignments, homework, and educational materials:

📈 Graphs & Charts

  • Bar, line, pie, scatter plots
  • Real-time data visualizations
  • Interactive charts (hover, click, zoom)
  • Statistical displays

🗺️ Diagrams & Visualizations

  • Mermaid diagrams (flowcharts, sequence)
  • Timelines and concept maps
  • Process flows and decision trees
  • Venn diagrams, org charts

✅ Interactive Assessments

  • Multiple choice (auto-graded)
  • Drag-and-drop matching
  • Fill-in-the-blank
  • Adaptive difficulty quizzes

🎨 Rich Media

  • ASCII art, SVG animations
  • Annotated images
  • Video with timestamps
  • Canvas-based drawings

💻 Code & Technical

  • Syntax-highlighted code
  • Runnable sandboxed snippets
  • Step-by-step walkthroughs
  • HTML/CSS live previews

📚 Learning Aids

  • Flashcards / notecards
  • Vocabulary builders
  • ELI5 expansions
  • Multi-modal explanations

customSections.title: 📝 Example Assignment Types
customSections.html:
Examples of assignments that can be created with embedded content:

📊 Math: Data Analysis

Analyze interactive chart, answer questions about trends, create visualization from data.

🔬 Science: Process Flow

Drag-and-drop to arrange steps of photosynthesis with embedded diagram.

📜 History: Timeline

Place events in order with embedded videos and images for each era.

💻 Coding: Live Challenge

Write code in sandbox, real-time output, auto-graded test cases.

🌍 Geography: Map Quiz

Click regions on interactive map with population/economic charts.

📖 Language: Flashcards

Audio pronunciation, spaced repetition, progress tracking.

notes: 2026-02-07: This storyline combines homework/assignment system with embeddable content showcase. The showcase page itself is a marketing tool—demonstrating what's possible while being the interface teachers use to build content. Key features from product-notes: psychological safety for teachers, AI pipelines for content improvement, anti-cheat systems, accessibility features, 1Game integration, EdLink auth. Design: Read-only focused on display, data in JSON, React/MUI, light/dark mode, collapsible sections, monochrome with opacity variations.
